params.name: extension
params.description: Optional file extension hint, such as pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, html, json, csv, md, py, rtf, jpg, png, or txt.

params.name: includeImages
params.description: Include image references in Markdown output

params.name: shortenBase64Images
params.description: Shorten base64-encoded image data in the Markdown output

params.name: useMainContentOnly
params.description: Extract only the main content from HTML-like inputs

params.name: ocr
params.description: When true for PDF inputs, detect and OCR images embedded in the selected pages, inserting recognized text at each image's position in page reading order while preserving the PDF text layer. pdf.start/pdf.end limit the inclusive page range. When false, all OCR is disabled, including the automatic scanned-PDF fallback.

params.name: pdf
params.description: PDF page-range options as a JSON object, e.g. {"start": 2, "end": 5}.

params.name: client
params.description: Optional client identifier used for usage attribution.

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional comma-separated caller-defined tags for tracking this request. Tags are recorded on the request's usage log and can be used to filter usage on the dashboard usage page. Up to 20 tags, each 1-50 characters.

items.docs: Converts raw text, source code, web/data, PDF, Microsoft Office, and image bytes into LLM-usable Markdown.
